title: A Clinical Study to Assess the Efficacy of Adjuvant Immunotherapy With Cemiplimab in Patients With Surgically Removed Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Who Have Not Received Prior Chemotherapy
note: Simplified for the demo, not the full protocol. Key criteria only.

question.instructions: What stage is this patient's non-small cell lung cancer? Choose MATCH if the record documents stage II, IIA, IIB or IIIA. Choose NO_MATCH if it documents stage I, IIIB, IIIC or IV, or there's no lung cancer. Choose UNKNOWN if lung cancer is present but no stage is recorded.

criteria.text: Complete surgical removal (lobectomy, sleeve lobectomy, bilobectomy, pneumonectomy, or segmentectomy for small tumors; wedge resection not allowed)
criteria.notes: Clear surgical margins (R0) are confirmed from the pathology report at screening.

criteria.text: Tumor PD-L1 expression of at least 1%, with archival tissue available
criteria.reason: From the pathology report; not in the record.

criteria.text: Not getting adjuvant platinum chemotherapy, because the patient declined or is unfit for it
criteria.reason: An oncologist's decision, documented in notes.

criteria.text: Prior neoadjuvant or adjuvant systemic treatment for this lung cancer
criteria.notes: Any chemotherapy on file counts. Checking whether it was for this cancer is a screening question.

criteria.text: Heart attack in the last 6 months
